title: Hierarchical Role-Based Access Control Evaluator
description: Implement an RBAC evaluator that traverses role inheritance hierarchies with loop detection.
derived_requirements: Resolve inherited roles without infinite loops (cycle detection)
Deny by default on unknown permissions
Cache resolved permission sets with TTL invalidation on role update

required_behavior: Detect circular role inheritance (A -> B -> A) and fail safely
Grant permission if any direct or inherited role possesses it
forbidden_behavior: Hanging in infinite recursion on circular role graphs
Allowing unauthorized actions on evaluation error

failure_taxonomy.description: Circular role assignment causes stack overflow or hang.

ground_truth_rationale: Access control engines must be mathematically deterministic and fail-closed.
